notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Some fixes for certain game breaking bugs.

- During massacre, sometimes reentering the mansion would not let you leave, no longer.
- During the massacre, going to the Cerdess house would make the player invisible, no longer.

notes.title: Release Day!
notes.content: Crimson Light, the prequel of Crimson Shift releases on the 12th of june for FREE on steam!! Enjoy!!
